entities.name: John the Baptist
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jewish prophet (c. 6 BCE – c. 29 CE) who prepared the way for Jesus by preaching repentance and baptizing in the Jordan River. Identified as the fulfillment of Malachi's prophecy of a returned Elijah. Executed by Herod Antipas at the request of Salome.
